schema.help: The marked place is the zebra crossing or the official passage.

options.text: Cars or motorcycles do not stop at the zebra crossing
Vehicles go through the red light
Motorcycles or e-scooters ride on the sidewalk
Motorcycles and mopeds weaving between stopped cars while people cross
People cross outside the marked place
People cross against the red light
Vehicles stop or park on the crossing or passage

it.#The marked place is the zebra crossing: Il punto segnalato è l’attraversamento pedonale o il passaggio ufficiale.
it.#Cars or motorcycles do not stop at the: Auto o moto che non si fermano alle strisce pedonali
it.#Motorcycles or e-scooters ride on the s: Moto o monopattini che vanno sul marciapiede
it.#Motorcycles and mopeds weaving between: Moto e motorini che passano tra le auto ferme mentre si attraversa
it.#People cross outside the marked place: Le persone attraversano fuori dal punto segnalato
it.#People cross against the red light: Le persone attraversano con il rosso
it.#People cycle in pedestrian-only space: Persone in bicicletta usano spazi riservati a chi va a piedi
it.#People walk in bicycle-only space: Persone a piedi usano spazi riservati alle biciclette
it.#Vehicles stop or park on the crossing o: I veicoli si fermano o parcheggiano sull'attraversamento o sul passaggio

fr.#The marked place is the zebra crossing: L’endroit marqué est le passage piéton ou le passage officiel.
fr.#Cars or motorcycles do not stop at the: Les voitures ou les motos ne s'arrêtent pas au passage piéton
fr.#Vehicles go through the red light: Des véhicules passent au feu rouge
fr.#Motorcycles or e-scooters ride on the s: Des motos ou des trottinettes électriques roulent sur le trottoir
fr.#Motorcycles and mopeds weaving between: Motos et scooters qui se faufilent entre les voitures arrêtées pendant qu'on traverse
fr.#People cross outside the marked place: Des personnes traversent en dehors du passage marqué
fr.#People cross against the red light: Des personnes traversent au feu rouge
fr.#People cycle in pedestrian-only space: Des personnes circulent à vélo dans un espace réservé aux piétons
fr.#People walk in bicycle-only space: Des personnes marchent dans un espace réservé aux vélos
fr.#Vehicles stop or park on the crossing o: Des véhicules s'arrêtent ou se garent sur la traversée ou le passage

de.#The marked place is the zebra crossing: Die markierte Stelle ist der Zebrastreifen oder der offizielle Durchgang.
de.#Cars or motorcycles do not stop at the: Autos oder Motorräder halten am Zebrastreifen nicht an
de.#Motorcycles or e-scooters ride on the s: Motorräder oder E-Scooter fahren auf dem Gehweg
de.#Motorcycles and mopeds weaving between: Motorräder und Motorroller, die zwischen stehenden Autos durchfahren, während man überquert
de.#People cycle in pedestrian-only space: Personen fahren im reinen Fußgängerbereich Rad
de.#People walk in bicycle-only space: Personen gehen im reinen Fahrradbereich zu Fuß
de.#Vehicles stop or park on the crossing o: Fahrzeuge halten oder parken auf dem Übergang oder Durchgang

tr.#The marked place is the zebra crossing: İşaretli yer, yaya geçidi veya resmî geçittir.
tr.#Cars or motorcycles do not stop at the: Arabalar veya motosikletler yaya geçidinde durmuyor
tr.#Motorcycles or e-scooters ride on the s: Motosikletler veya elektrikli scooterlar kaldırımda gidiyor
tr.#Motorcycles and mopeds weaving between: Karşıya geçilirken duran arabaların arasından geçen motosiklet ve mopetler

tr.#People walk in bicycle-only space: İnsanlar yalnızca bisiklete ayrılmış alanda yürüyor
tr.#Vehicles stop or park on the crossing o: Araçlar geçidin üzerinde duruyor veya park ediyor

fa.#The marked place is the zebra crossing: محل مشخص‌شده همان خط‌کشی عابر پیاده یا گذرگاه رسمی است.
fa.#Cars or motorcycles do not stop at the: خودروها یا موتورسیکلت‌ها پشت خط عابر پیاده نمی‌ایستند
fa.#Vehicles go through the red light: وسایل نقلیه از چراغ قرمز عبور می‌کنند
fa.#Motorcycles or e-scooters ride on the s: موتورسیکلت‌ها یا اسکوترهای برقی روی پیاده‌رو حرکت می‌کنند
fa.#Motorcycles and mopeds weaving between: موتورسیکلت‌ها و موتورهای گازی که هنگام عبور از میان خودروهای ایستاده رد می‌شوند
fa.#People cross outside the marked place: مردم بیرون از محل علامت‌گذاری‌شده عبور می‌کنند
fa.#People cross against the red light: مردم با چراغ قرمز عبور می‌کنند
fa.#People cycle in pedestrian-only space: مردم در فضای ویژه عابر پیاده دوچرخه‌سواری می‌کنند
fa.#People walk in bicycle-only space: مردم در فضای ویژه دوچرخه پیاده راه می‌روند
fa.#Vehicles stop or park on the crossing o: وسایل نقلیه روی گذرگاه یا معبر می‌ایستند یا پارک می‌کنند

hu.#The marked place is the zebra crossing: A kijelölt hely a zebra vagy a hivatalos átjáró.
hu.#Cars or motorcycles do not stop at the: Az autók vagy motorok nem állnak meg a zebránál
hu.#Motorcycles or e-scooters ride on the s: Motorok vagy elektromos rollerek mennek a járdán
hu.#Motorcycles and mopeds weaving between: Motorok és robogók, amelyek átkelés közben a megálló autók között cikáznak
hu.#People cross outside the marked place: Az emberek a kijelölt helyen kívül kelnek át
hu.#People cross against the red light: Az emberek piros jelzésnél kelnek át
hu.#People cycle in pedestrian-only space: Az emberek csak gyalogosoknak fenntartott helyen kerékpároznak
hu.#People walk in bicycle-only space: Az emberek csak kerékpárosoknak fenntartott helyen gyalogolnak
hu.#Vehicles stop or park on the crossing o: Járművek megállnak vagy parkolnak az átkelőn vagy átjárón

ar.#The marked place is the zebra crossing: المكان المحدد هو ممر المشاة المخطط أو الممر الرسمي.
ar.#Cars or motorcycles do not stop at the: السيارات أو الدراجات النارية لا تتوقف عند ممر المشاة
ar.#Motorcycles or e-scooters ride on the s: دراجات نارية أو سكوترات كهربائية تسير على الرصيف
ar.#Motorcycles and mopeds weaving between: دراجات نارية وصغيرة تمر بين السيارات المتوقفة أثناء العبور
ar.#People cycle in pedestrian-only space: يركب الناس الدراجات في مساحة مخصصة للمشاة فقط
ar.#People walk in bicycle-only space: يمشي الناس في مساحة مخصصة للدراجات فقط
ar.#Vehicles stop or park on the crossing o: مركبات تتوقف أو تركن على المعبر أو الممر
